ExtraBar 1.4.2 – Private on Screen, Smarter Hotkeys & a Sharper Menu Bar Icon! 🕶️⌨️✨

Hide the bar from screen recordings and shares, take control of the hotkeys that were quietly missing, and enjoy a menu bar icon that finally looks and stays right.

✨ New Features

  • Hide from Screen Capture: A new Privacy toggle in Settings → General keeps the floating bar and its bookmark popovers/panels out of screenshots, screen recordings, and screen sharing — Zoom, QuickTime, ScreenCaptureKit and more! Menu bar icons aren't affected, and turning it back off instantly makes the bar capturable again!
  • Toggle Notch Mode Hotkey: Toggle Notch Mode now has its own row in Hotkeys settings — it was always registered on ⌥⌘N but had no way to change or remove it, and now you're in control!
  • Honest Collapse Mode Hotkey: Toggle Collapse Mode now tells you when it's inert — the shortcut row shows "Unavailable while Single Menu Merge is on" instead of silently doing nothing!

🔧 Improvements

  • Reliable Toggle Position Shortcut: The Toggle Position default is now ⌥⌘P — macOS reserves ⌥⌘M system-wide, so the old default was rejected by the recorder and never reached the app! Any custom shortcut you've already recorded stays untouched!
  • Adaptive Menu Bar Icon: The default menu bar icon now renders as a template image with a transparent background, so it picks up the right contrast in light and dark menu bars instead of showing an opaque colored tile!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Menu Bar Icon Position Persists: The menu bar icon's position, set by ⌘-dragging, now sticks across relaunches!
  • ⌘, Opens Settings: The standard Command-Comma shortcut now opens Settings as expected!
  • Reset Defaults Really Resets: Reset Defaults in Hotkeys settings now actually restores the shortcut defaults — previously it only reset the timing and indicator options!
  • Cleaner Icon Preview: The menu bar icon preview in Appearance no longer mutates the shared cached icon image!

What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraBar more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
